prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1338
Claimant:
Brian Hernandez
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
15 Apr 2023
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured vehicle and a second vehicle. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
24 Apr 2023
Confirmed that the driver of the insured vheicle is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of
the loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2 May 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Witness statements and
scene photos are consistent with the account given at first notice.
25 Jun 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who described the collision the same way the claimant did. Their account matches the
sequence recorded by the responding officer.
21 Aug 2023
Reviewed the vehicle file and found no prior damage to the vehicle on record. The repair estimate covers the visible
side panels and door structure from this impact.
7 Sep 2023
Claimant reports neck and upper back pain consistent with whiplash following the collision. The reported symptoms
are a plausible result of a crash of this type.
15 Oct 2023
Medical records show treatment followed a usual course, with symptoms easing steadily as the patient improved. No
prior injury to the same body area appears in the records provided.
22 Oct 2023
Called counsel to request the complete treatment history and billing. Counsel agreed to provide the records within the
agreed timeframe.
8 Nov 2023
Spoke with the claimant again, who gave the same account of the accident as in earlier conversations, with no
changes to the sequence or the injuries described.
11 Nov 2023
Reviewed the repair photos against the damage pattern. It is not yet clear whteher all of the damage came from this
impact, so the independent appraiser has been asked to check the lower body panels.
22 Nov 2023
Appraiser review requested and medical records under review. Claim remains open pending the appraisal findings
and final treatment billing.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
